provenance.note: All voices are synthetic (Gemini TTS prebuilt voices). No recording of a real person. Resampled from 24 kHz to 16 kHz; leading and trailing silence trimmed; otherwise unprocessed.

fixtures.text: What is the capital of France?
fixtures.purpose: A short factual question: audio turn, latency.

fixtures.text: When I was a child, we lived in a small house near the river,
fixtures.purpose: First half of a sentence; the patience check inserts a silent gap after it.

fixtures.text: and every summer my grandmother baked apple pies for the whole street.
fixtures.purpose: Second half of the sentence started in story-part-1.

fixtures.text: The seven yellow apples are in the garden by the window.
fixtures.purpose: A sentence of distinct words for input-transcription accuracy. (A bare word list came back from TTS at over eight seconds, beyond the fixture size limit.)

fixtures.text: Excuse me, sorry to interrupt, but please stop for a moment. I have a different question for you.
fixtures.purpose: Several seconds of continuous speech to interrupt the bot with.

fixtures.text: Okay, that's everything I needed today. Thank you, goodbye.
fixtures.purpose: A clear sign-off, for apps that test their end-of-session tool.
